rationale: C19 plausibly supplied a material structural template: it first defines a complex national problem spanning economic, international, security, governmental, and private interests; rejects fragmented treatment; then assigns a named individual to lead a broad policy review, coordinate relevant participants, and develop recommendations. The child adapts this machinery to international economic policy by appointing Gray as Special Assistant, charging him with coordinating multiple agencies, consulting outside experts and interested groups, defining the problem, and developing broad policy for presentation to the public and Congress. C17 is also a strong parallel commission-assignment letter, while C18 contains a shorter version of the study-and-outside-consultation structure. C19 is strongest because of its close timing and fuller parallel progression from complex cross-sector problem to coordinated policy review.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This complex problem... involves many agencies of this Government.... I have decided to appoint you as Special Assistant to the President to assist in this task.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Problems such as these cannot adequately be considered on a piecemeal basis.... I am therefore establishing by Executive order a temporary Communications Policy Board... to study and to make recommendations to me
shared_material.explanation: Both move from a complex, cross-cutting policy problem to creation of a presidentially directed mechanism for comprehensive study and policy recommendations.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Your principal role... will be to advise and assist in coordinating and stimulating the activities of the various Governmental agencies.... I shall also look to you to obtain the views of experts and interested groups outside the Government
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Board shall study the present and potential use... by governmental and non-governmental agencies.... I am sure that you will receive the full cooperation and assistance of all parties concerned.
shared_material.explanation: The assignments share the concrete administrative machinery of coordinating government bodies while incorporating nongovernmental participants.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The first phase of our work is to determine the nature, dimensions, and significance of this problem. In the light of this understanding, we must develop the broad lines of policy
shared_material.parent_excerpt: An over-all, objective review of this entire situation is urgently needed.... to study and to make recommendations to me on the policies and practices which should be followed by the Federal Government
shared_material.explanation: Both prescribe an initial comprehensive diagnosis followed by formulation of broad federal policy.
